question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**exclude**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The context indicates that Federico felt alone despite no one explicitly trying to do something negative to him.
 
• 'Exclude' means to intentionally leave out or not include, which fits the context of him feeling alone due to the potential lack of inclusion by others.
 
• Other options like 'fabricate,' 'incorporate,' and 'stratify' do not fit the context of the passage. Specifically:
 
 
• 'Fabricate' means to invent or concoct something, typically with deceitful intent, which does not fit here.
 
• 'Incorporate' means to include or integrate, which is the opposite of what the context suggests.
 
• 'Stratify' means to arrange or classify, which is unrelated to the context.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 1'.

 

Complete Passage: * The mathematician Federico Ardila-Mantilla grew up in Colombia, an **indifferent**__ student but gifted in math. He was failing most of his classes at his high school in Bogotá when someone __**suggested**__ him to apply to MIT. He had not heard of the school. To his surprise, he got in, and he went on scholarship. Mathematically, he did well. One of his professors, an acid-tongued theoretician known to __**compare**__ his audience to a herd of cows, routinely tucked 'open' math problems into homework assignments, without telling the students. These had never been solved by anyone. Ardila solved one. He went on to receive his bachelor's and Ph.D. in math from MIT. But his academic experience was also one of isolation. Part of it had to do with his own __**introversion**__. Part of it was cultural. As a Latino, he was very much in the minority in the department, and he did not feel comfortable in American mathematical spaces. No one had tried to explicitly __**exclude**__ him, yet he felt alone. In math, collaborating with others opens up new kinds of learning and thinking. But in his nine years at MIT, Ardila worked with others only twice. * 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Fabricate (घड़ना): 'Fabricate' means to invent something in order to deceive, which does not fit the context.
 
• Incorporate (शामिल करना): 'Incorporate' means to include or integrate, which is the opposite of the idea of exclusion.
 
• Stratify (विभाजित करना): 'Stratify' means to arrange or classify, which is unrelated to the context.
